commit: fix(markdown): do not print trailing commas in arrow function type parameter lists in ts code blocks

truth.description: mayBeTsx now keeps the forced comma in embedded code only when the embedding printer passes a .tsx filepath, which only the Markdown embed does, but the HTML and Vue embed in src/language-html/embed.js formats a <script lang="tsx"> block with the typescript parser and no filepath of its own, so const identity = <T,>(value: T) => value; in that block now prints as <T>(value: T) => value, which TSX reads as a JSX tag.

distractions.why: A ts or typescript code block is parsed as TypeScript without JSX, so <T>(value: T) => {} cannot be read as a tag there and dropping the comma is the requested output.
